scripts.format: bunx biome format --write . && bun --cwd=apps/api run format && bun --cwd=apps/dashboard run format && bun --cwd=apps/docs run format

scripts.vars: bun scripts/generate-tfvars.ts && bun scripts/oidc-key.ts && bun scripts/ssh-ca-key.ts
